# ws source provenance

Official websockets/ws release 8.22.1: https://github.com/websockets/ws/releases/tag/8.22.1
Runtime files and LICENSE fetched through the connected GitHub read API. Every file was checked against its official Git blob SHA-1 before saving. Upstream runtime source is unmodified; optional native addons are not installed. The local file dependency is packed with --install-links to avoid installing upstream development dependencies.

No custom WebSocket protocol implementation or pip/platform workaround is used.
